name: Ariane 6
dispatch: Ariane 6 is Europe's answer to a market it no longer dominates. For two decades Ariane owned commercial launch; then reusable rockets undercut its prices and ended that reign. Ariane 6, flying from 2024, is the established power's response to the disruptive one — cheaper and more flexible than Ariane 5, built to keep Europe's independent access to space alive as the economics of launch are rewritten around it. Whether an expendable rocket can hold its ground against reusable rivals is the open question it now carries.
description: Ariane 6 is a orbital launcher built by ArianeGroup in Multi (Europe). Successor to Ariane 5. In service since 2024.
